16*10/100/1000Base-T + 2*1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+
L3 Managed Industrial Ethernet Switch
LT-IS6518XG-2XS16GT
Features:
➢ 16*10/100/1000Base-T RJ45, 4*1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+
➢ DC 12-58V input, redundant power supply with polarity reverse/over-current protection
➢  Support one digital output for relay alarm (terminal block Pin 5/6)
➢ Layer 3 features: Support IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server, DHCP relay; Support ECMP, VRRP, RIP, OSPF, BGP4, IS-IS; 13K routing entries
➢  Layer 2 features: VLAN/GVRP/QinQ/SPAN/RSPAN/STP, RSTP, MSTP/DHCP/Multicast/ACL
QoS/LLDP/802.1X/AAA/Loop Detect/Dying Gasp/SFP DDM/IPV6 management/Dual Stack/ sFlow/Web/SNMP/MQTT/Telnet/TFTP/Web upgrading
➢ Support G.8032 ERPS protocol, recovery time ≤20ms
➢ Support 6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
➢ IP40 fan-less and Din-rail hardware design
➢ Operation temperature: -40 ℃ ~+75℃
Overview
The SmartByte LT-IS6518XG-2XS16GT is the highly reliable managed industrial Ethernet switch with 16-port 10/100/1000-T, 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X SFP+. In normal operation, it is a L3 managed Ethernet switch. It supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution. It also supports DI/DO/RS485, DHCP server, DHCP relay, IPv4/IPv6 static routing and dynamic routing protocols like RIP, OSPFv2, BGP4, IS-IS, robust Layer 2 management and secure functions, which can help users expand their networks quickly and efficiently.
LT-IS6518XG-2XS16GT is also the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 12-58VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy industrial factory, transportation, oil & gas, chemical, IP Surveillance and processing automation area where environmental conditions are harsh and critical.
